nodes.description: Ownable._owner: private address holding the contract owner used by onlyOwner checks and transferred in transferOwnership/renounceOwnership.
constant bytes32 namehash('addr.reverse') used to look up the ENS reverse registrar owner.
public string rootName, human readable ENS root name (e.g. mirror.xyz) used to build reverse-ENS names.
immutable bytes32 rootNode, namehash of the managed root name, passed to ENS registry calls.
immutable IENS ensRegistry, external ENS registry contract invoked for owner lookups and record mutations.
immutable address writeToken, the only address allowed to call register via onlyWriteToken.
immutable IENSResolver ensResolver, external resolver contract that stores forward and reverse addresses/names.
mutable IENSReverseRegistrar reverseRegistrar, set by anyone/owner via updateENSReverseRegistrar and read during register.
Context._msgSender(): internal view returning msg.sender; the source of the deployer/owner identity.
Context._msgData(): internal view returning msg.data.
Ownable.owner(): public view returning the stored _owner address.
Ownable.renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner function that clears _owner to address(0).
Ownable.transferOwnership(address newOwner): onlyOwner function that reassigns _owner to the caller-supplied address.
MirrorENSRegistrar constructor: sets rootName, rootNode, writeToken, ensRegistry and ensResolver, and through Ownable sets the initial owner from _msgSender().

register(string label_, address owner_): onlyWriteToken entrypoint that derives the node, checks ENS ownership, writes forward ENS records and the reverse ENS name; makes multiple untrusted external calls.
changeRootNodeOwner(address _newOwner): onlyOwner function transferring the root node ownership in the ENS registry.
updateENSReverseRegistrar(): onlyOwner function refreshing the cached reverseRegistrar from the ENS registry owner of ADDR_REVERSE_NODE.
msg.sender: attacker-controllable caller identity used for onlyWriteToken and onlyOwner access checks.
External call ensRegistry.setSubnodeRecord(...): mutates the external ENS registry with attacker-influenced owner_/label values before subsequent calls.
External call ensResolver.setAddr(node, owner_): writes the forward address record into the external resolver.
External call ensResolver.setName(reverseNode, name): writes the reverse name record into the external resolver.
External call ensRegistry.setOwner(rootNode, _newOwner): permanently hands over the root node in the external ENS registry.
External call reverseRegistrar.node(owner_): reads the reverse node for an address from a caller-influenced registrar address.
External call ensRegistry.owner(node/ADDR_REVERSE_NODE) used both as a registration guard and to derive the reverse registrar.
Constructor parameter rootName_: the ENS root name string stored in rootName.
Constructor parameter rootNode_: namehash of the root name stored in immutable rootNode.
Constructor parameter ensRegistry_: address used to instantiate the ensRegistry interface.
Constructor parameter ensResolver_: address used to instantiate the ensResolver interface.
Constructor parameter writeToken_: address stored as writeToken and required by onlyWriteToken.
register parameter label_: the subdomain label hashed into labelNode and embedded into the reverse name.
register parameter owner_: the address that receives the subnode ownership and forward address record.
changeRootNodeOwner parameter _newOwner: new owner of the ENS root node.
transferOwnership parameter newOwner: new contract owner; rejected if address(0).
Local variable msgSender in Ownable constructor holding _msgSender() before writing to _owner.
Local variable labelNode = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(label_)) used as the subnode label.
Local variable node = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(rootNode, labelNode)) used for ownership check and setAddr.
Local variable name = label_ + "." + rootName used as the reverse ENS name.
Local variable reverseNode returned by reverseRegistrar.node(owner_).

register() calls the external ensRegistry.owner() existence check and reverts if the label is owned.
register() invokes ensRegistry.setSubnodeRecord to create the forward record.
register() invokes ensResolver.setAddr after the registry write.
register() invokes reverseRegistrar.node(owner_) to derive the reverse node.
register() invokes ensResolver.setName to store the reverse name.
changeRootNodeOwner() invokes ensRegistry.setOwner on the root node.
updateENSReverseRegistrar() invokes ensRegistry.owner(ADDR_REVERSE_NODE) to refresh cached state.
External setSubnodeRecord call in register() hands control to the ENS registry before the remaining resolver writes and the event emission complete.
External setAddr call in register() transfers control to the resolver between the forward and reverse ENS writes.
External setName call in register() executes before the RegisteredENS event, allowing re-entry into register().
External setOwner call in changeRootNodeOwner() returns control to the caller before the RootNodeOwnerChange event is emitted.
